crossRefs.note: Now in the twenty-fourth day of this month the children of Israel were assembled with fasting, with sackcloth, and dirt…
Gather the people. Sanctify the assembly. Assemble the elders. Gather the children, and those who nurse from breasts.…
Then Samuel took a stone, and set it between Mizpah and Shen, and called its name Ebenezer, saying, “Yahweh helped us…
He went from year to year in a circuit to Bethel, Gilgal, and Mizpah; and he judged Israel in all those places.
Samuel called the people together to Yahweh to Mizpah;
Then all the children of Israel went out, and the congregation was assembled as one man, from Dan even to Beersheba…
Now when all the captains of the forces, they and their men, heard that the king of Babylon had made Gedaliah governor…
Moreover as for me, far be it from me that I should sin against Yahweh in ceasing to pray for you: but I will instruct…

people.name: Israel
people.line: Patriarch, son of Isaac, father of twelve tribes

people.name: Mizpah
people.line: A city in Benjamin; a place of gathering and judgment

people.name: Samuel
people.line: Prophet and last judge of Israel before the kings

translations.web: Samuel said, “Gather all Israel to Mizpah, and I will pray to Yahweh for you.”
translations.bsb: Then Samuel said, “Gather all Israel to Mizpah, and I will pray to the LORD on your behalf.”
translations.kjv: And Samuel said, Gather all Israel to Mizpeh, and I will pray for you unto the LORD.
translations.asv: And Samuel said, Gather all Israel to Mizpah, and I will pray for you unto Jehovah.
